title: Senior– Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC) -Technical Program Management (TPM)
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Are you ready to lead complex engineering programs that require strong planning, cross-team coordination, and disciplined execution? Deloitte is seeking a Senior - Technical Program Management (TPM) professional to drive integrated engineering schedules, manage dependencies, identify delivery risks early, and help ensure business commitments are met across global technology initiatives. In this role, you will work closely with product, engineering, and leadership teams to bring structure, transparency, and operational rigor to enterprise-scale delivery.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior - Technical Program Management (TPM) on the GES Technology Group team, you will be responsible for coordinating engineering delivery plans, aligning stakeholders, and driving execution across one or more domains.
  
  

* Own and maintain integrated engineering schedules for assigned domains, including milestones, delivery dates, and schedule updates tied to product and engineering decisions
* Track and manage dependencies across teams, domains, and product areas; facilitate issue resolution to reduce delivery blockers and improve execution visibility
* Identify and monitor risks related to scope, resources, dependencies, and execution; maintain mitigation plans and escalate unresolved issues with context and recommendations
* Partner with product owners, product managers, engineering managers, and leadership teams to align priorities, capacity, milestones, and delivery commitments
* Develop domain knowledge across architecture, release cadence, team structure, and workstream impacts to assess schedule changes and support informed delivery decisions

**The team**
At Deloitte Tax LLP, the Global Employer Services (GES) Technology Group helps multinational clients develop programs, processes, and digital offerings to manage global workforce needs and compliance obligations tied to mobility, business travel, and remote work. The team partners with go-to-market teams and global clients to solve business and technology challenges, design digital experiences, and build products that support compliance with global and local regulations.
  
  
**Location: Hyderabad**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in technical program management or engineering program management within software product environments
* Experience owning integrated engineering schedules across multiple teams, including milestones, delivery dates, and dependency tracking
* Experience managing cross-functional dependencies across engineering teams, product teams, platforms, or domains
* Experience working with software development life cycle models, including Agile, Scaled Agile Framework, or hybrid delivery methodologies
* Experience identifying, documenting, and escalating delivery risks related to scope, resources, dependencies, or execution
* Experience translating product scope and priority decisions into engineering delivery plans and status reporting

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with cloud architecture or multi-tier application environments
* Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, or comparable program tracking tools
* Project Management Professional or SAFe Agilist certification
* Knowledge of SOC 2 standards or data privacy regulations, including General Data Protection Regulation
* Experience working in regulated technology environments

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: IT&D Manager, Smart Execution
description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Information Technology & Digital
  
  
In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
  
  
Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
  
  
Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a strategic and commercially minded IT&D Manager to lead the Smart Execution capabilities of the Sales Execution platform globally. The primary role is to act as a bridge between business stakeholders and the technology teams, owning the roadmap of the solution and manage the on-going deployment and adoption within the markets. The ultimate objective is to deliver insights which create value and drive business forward in the space of route-to-market, in-store execution and sales excellence, whilst ensuring synergy, cost effectiveness and appropriate levels of data governance.
  
  
This candidate will need to demonstrate an effective communication and delivery skillset and collaborate confidently with mid-senior levels of the organisation. We are looking for someone who can innovate, with the ability to encourage performance and motivate peers and the wider organisation to embrace advanced data & analytics capabilities.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
Capability Management
  
  

* Define and own the feature roadmap for the Smart Execution capabilities, including RTM, Routing, In-store Execution and Order Recommendations
* Gather and translate business requirements from commercial and sales teams into technical user stories and acceptance criteria
* Prioritize backlogs and make decisions aligned to the business value
* Partner with the technology teams, data scientists, data engineers, analysts, and application developers to deliver the capabilities
* Manage the full technology lifecycle — from discovery and design through build, testing, and deployment
* Drive adoption of the Smart Execution capabilities across Sales (Retail Management, Key Account Management), Trade Marketing and Customer Supply, ensuring tools are effectively utilized to achieve business objectives
* Monitor usage and identify opportunities for improvement and enhancement
* Utilize a deep understanding of FMCG categories and external data to inform development and deployment strategies
* Work closely with other teams within Sales Execution Platform for a seamless integration of AI within existing workflows
* Manage vendor relationships, including implementation partners

Stakeholder Engagement:
  
  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for all stakeholders of capabilities managed, building and maintaining strong relationships, and driving adoption
* Manage and communicate Roadmaps, providing details of delivery timelines, training and deployment to regional and market users
* Collaborate with and provide expertise and support to market teams, developing action plans based on analytical insights, refine processes and unlock new capabilities

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  
  

* Partner with Global and Regional commercial teams to develop analytics best practices, maintain and deliver these in the markets in alignment with the IT operating model
* Work with other Global IT&D Managers within the Sales Execution team to ensure alignment and leveraging the synergies between teams
* Ensure alignment of the technical delivery with the Reckitt’s data analytics platform - Trinity data architecture standards, patterns and principles. Align changes where necessary
* Implement solutions aligned to global IT&D enterprise architecture frameworks

The experience we're looking for
  
  
6-8+ years in business analysis, data science consulting or IT Management (with exposure to AI Product Management)
  
  

* Proven experience in designing, deploying and adopting analytical tools within commercial teams
* Experience in working with the Sales functions
* Preferred experience for role:
* FMCG / Consumer Goods experience preferred
* Previous hand-on Data Science experience preferred
* Exposure to Modern Trade and/or Pharmacy/OTC sales channels

The skills for success
  
  

* Technical Skills
* Familiarity with Sales Execution solutions or platforms
* Familiarity with Azure tech stack and Microsoft Power Platforms
* Ability to guide AI model development, managing trade-offs between data availability, model accuracy and business value delivered
* Ability to evaluate model performance and translate model outputs into business insights to drive stakeholder buy-in
* Designing experiments to measure value delivered and inferring/extrapolating results
* Delivering end-to-end ad hoc analyses including scoping, problem translation, solution design and insights generation
* Awareness of impact of solution architecture and solution design choices on infrastructure requirements
* Ability to write or review functional specifications
* Familiarity with agile methodologies and cross-functional team collaboration

Business Acumen
  
  

* Strong grasp of Sales Execution levers: execution compliance, on-shelf availability, MSL, share of shelf etc.
* Ability to translate commercial strategy and processes into design and decisions

Soft Skills
  
  

* Excellent stakeholder management across senior commercial and IT leadership
* Strong communication — able to speak both “business” and “tech”
* Analytical mindset with comfort around large datasets

What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Cloud Services
description:
**Software Engineering Manager – Cloud Services**
Hyderabad, India (Hybrid – 3 days in office)
  
  
**About Nasuni**
Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams—and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world’s unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits. As a Vista-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next-generation, AI-ready platform—turning massive file stores into secure, actionable, and AI-ready data for intelligent automation, analytics, and global collaboration.
  
  
**Why Work at Nasuni (Hyderabad / India)**
With Vista Equity Partners’ backing, our Hyderabad team benefits from access to a global ecosystem of software leaders—cross-portfolio learning, leadership programs, and AI innovation communities—combining the pace of a fast-growing company with the scale and resources of a global technology investor. You’ll innovate at the intersection of cloud, AI, and enterprise data infrastructure, collaborate with talented teams, and build modern platforms trusted by enterprises worldwide. Join us in Hyderabad and help shape the future of intelligent, AI-ready data management.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Nasuni is hiring a
**Software Engineering Manager – Cloud Services**
to lead the team responsible for building and operating cloud-native services that strengthen our platform’s ransomware detection and data protection capabilities.
  
  
These services process large volumes of system data, prepare it for machine learning workflows, and integrate detection capabilities into production systems that help enterprises protect and recover critical file data.
  
  
This role is ideal for a
**hands-on engineering leader**
who combines:
  
  

* strong Python and distributed systems experience
* AWS cloud architecture expertise
* the ability to lead engineers and deliver reliable cloud services

This role focuses on
**engineering leadership and delivery execution**
, not cybersecurity research or machine learning model development.
  
  
**Level & Scope Definition**
**In This Role You Will**

* Lead and develop a team of approximately 5 software engineers.
* Own delivery of cloud-native services supporting ransomware detection infrastructure.
* Provide technical direction for Python-based distributed systems.
* Partner with Product, Security, Cloud Platform, and SRE teams.
* Ensure systems meet reliability, scalability, and security requirements.

You will remain
**technically engaged**
, participating in architecture discussions and reviewing critical code paths, while focusing primarily on
**team leadership, delivery predictability, and system reliability**
.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead a team of software engineers building cloud-native services within Nasuni’s Cloud Services platform.
* Design and evolve Python-based services that collect and process system data used for ransomware detection workflows.
* Architect scalable systems leveraging AWS services such as S3 and event-driven data pipelines.
* Ensure cloud services meet high standards for security, reliability, and observability.
* Drive Agile execution including sprint planning, estimation discipline, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
* Establish disciplined engineering practices using delivery metrics and data-informed planning.
* Conduct performance management and coach engineers for technical and career growth.
* Review system designs and provide technical direction grounded in deep system understanding.
* Collaborate with Security, Platform, and SRE teams to strengthen detection and recovery capabilities.
* Leverage modern engineering tools—including AI-assisted development workflows—to improve team productivity while maintaining strong validation and quality standards.

**Qualifications**
**Must-Have Qualifications**

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* 2+ years of direct engineering management experience.
* Strong Python development experience in production systems.
* Hands-on experience designing or operating AWS-based distributed systems.
* Experience building scalable backend services or data-processing systems.
* Experience leading Agile software development teams.
* Ability to understand complex system data flows and architect improvements across services.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building data pipelines that support machine learning workflows.
* Experience integrating ML-driven detection capabilities into production systems.
* Familiarity with AWS S3 and object storage architectures.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
* Experience working in security, ransomware protection, or data protection domains.
* Familiarity with file systems or SMB protocols.

**Ideal Qualifications**

* Experience building anomaly detection or security telemetry systems.
* Experience operating high-availability SaaS infrastructure.
* Demonstrated ability to balance hands-on technical engagement with team leadership.
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve development productivity.

**Experience Guidelines**

* 8–15 years total software engineering experience
* 2–5 years engineering management experience
* 3+ years AWS production system experience

**Why Work at Nasuni – Hyderabad?**
**Benefits**
As part of our commitment to your well-being and growth, Nasuni offers
**competitive benefits**
designed to support every stage of your life and career:
  
  

* Competitive compensation programs
* Flexible time off and leave policies
* Comprehensive health and wellness coverage
* Hybrid and flexible work arrangements
* Employee referral and recognition programs
* Professional development and learning support
* Inclusive, collaborative team culture
* Modern office spaces with team events and perks
* Retirement and statutory benefits as per Indian regulations

*Nasuni is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where every team member can thrive. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, caste, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, national origin, or any other status protected by applicable laws in India or the country of employment.*
*We celebrate individuality and are committed to building a workplace that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know.*

title: Lead - Ground Systems Software Engineering
description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced
**Lead / Manager - Ground Systems Software Engineering**
to lead the architecture, development, integration, deployment, and lifecycle of mission-critical Ground Systems for command and control, telemetry, mission operations, situational awareness, monitoring, and data distribution.

The ideal candidate combines expertise in software engineering, systems integration, cloud-native and real-time distributed systems with strong delivery leadership, guiding multidisciplinary teams and cross-functional partners to build reliable, scalable, secure, high-performance solutions.

The role also drives technical strategy, architecture governance, resource and talent planning, risk management, and successful program execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Software Development & Architecture**

* Lead the architecture, design, development, and maintenance of Ground System software applications and services.
* Define technology roadmaps and software engineering best practices for Ground Systems.
* Drive architecture reviews, design governance, and technical decision-making across programs.
* Ensure software solutions meet performance, reliability, scalability, maintainability, and security requirements.
* Champion modern software engineering practices including DevSecOps, CI/CD, containerization, and microservices-based architectures.
* Establish coding standards, development frameworks, and software quality assurance processes.

**Ground Systems Integration**

* Oversee integration of software with telemetry systems, communication networks, databases, mission systems, sensors, and external interfaces.
* Lead system integration, verification, validation, and operational readiness activities.
* Collaborate closely with hardware, network, infrastructure, and systems engineering teams.
* Drive root-cause analysis and resolution of complex software and integration issues.
* Ensure seamless deployment and operational transition of Ground System solutions.

**Program Delivery & Project Management**

* Own end-to-end delivery of Ground System software projects from concept to deployment.
* Develop project plans, resource allocation strategies, and execution roadmaps.
* Monitor project schedules, technical milestones, budgets, and deliverables.
* Manage technical risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure successful program execution.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 12-18+ years of software engineering experience.
* Minimum 3-5 years of technical leadership or engineering management experience.
* Proven experience leading large-scale software development and integration projects.
* Strong programming expertise in:
* Python, C/C++, Java (Preferred), Scripting Languages, Linux/Unix environments.
* Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Experience with Agile methodologies, DevOps/DevSecOps practices, and CI/CD frameworks.
* Expertise in Git-based development environments and software configuration management.
* Strong knowledge of communication protocols including:
* TCP/IP, UDP, Qt, HTTP/HTTPS, WebSocket, RS-232, RS-422, RS-485
* Experience in software architecture, distributed systems, and system integration.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with satellite ground systems, missile systems, mission control systems, or aerospace/defense applications.
* Strong understanding of Telemetry, Tracking & Command (TT&C) systems.
* Experience with C4ISR, Command & Control (C2), and Mission Planning Systems.
* Knowledge of distributed computing and real-time data processing architectures.
* Exposure to cloud-native platforms and container orchestration technologies.
* Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and secure defense software development practices.
* Experience in customer-facing program execution and technical leadership roles.
* Knowledge of aerospace and defense standards and mission-critical operational environments.

**Technical Skills**

**Programming**

* Python, C/C++, Java (Preferred), Shell Scripting, Qt

**Technologies**

* REST APIs, Microservices Architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, Distributed Systems, CI/CD Frameworks, Cloud-Native Applications

**Tools**

* Git, GitLab/GitHub, Jira, Jenkins, Linux Administration

title: Senior Structured Data Access Control Process Analyst
description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for
*all*
.**
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
  
  
The
**Senior Structured Data Access Control Process Analyst**
will play an important role in supporting Micron's Structured Data Access Control (sDAC) program and related data governance initiatives. This role analyzes business processes, identifies opportunities for automation and efficiency, develops reporting and dashboard solutions, supports operational workloads, and contributes to projects that strengthen secure and compliant access to enterprise structured data.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong analytical thinking with process improvement, stakeholder engagement, reporting, and project execution skills. Working closely with technical and business teams, they will transform complex governance processes into actionable insights and help drive continuous improvements across access management and governance workflows.
  
  
This position supports both day-to-day operations and strategic initiatives, helping advance governance modernization, workflow automation, and user experience improvements across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain a deep understanding of Structured Data Access Control (SDAC) process and related governance workflows along with the knowledge of Role Based Access Control (RBAC) and data security management for integration.
* Define, document and improve business processes, requirements, workflows, operating procedures, governance standards, user guidance, training material and communications.
* Identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, automation, and efficiency improvements.
* Leveraging AI powered tools and other technologies to improve analysis, research, and productivity.
* Serve as a project contributor, feature owner, or workstream lead for governance initiatives. Includes tracking and communicating project status, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and key milestones.
* Facilitate stakeholder discussions to understand business needs, gather requirements, and address process challenges.
* Facilitate partnerships with developers to define business requirements and acceptance criteria. Participate in requirements gathering, planning, testing, deployment, change management, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and validation activities.
* Collaborate with BISOs, architects, DBAs, developers, governance teams, and business stakeholders.
* Support user adoption efforts and partner with governance and security teams on RBAC-related initiatives.
* Perform deep data analysis to detect patterns and drive to results. Along with developing data-driven recommendations to improve service quality, cycle time, operational effectiveness, and user experience. Monitor service levels and operational health.
* Design, develop, and maintain Power BI, ServiceNow, and governance reporting solutions, dashboards, and operational metrics.
* Analyze trends, bottlenecks, Service Level Agreement (SLA) performance, and operational health metrics to provide actionable insights, create executive-ready reporting and present to leadership and stakeholder on governance recommendation.
* Support operational ticket queues, governance workflows, and triage and resolution of access request review along with assisting users and stakeholders with governance-related inquiries.
* Support audit, certification, and compliance activities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Information Systems, Business Data Analytics, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of work experience in business analysis, governance, operations, analytics, or process improvement.
* Experience gathering and documenting business requirements, developing reports, dashboards, and metrics using Power BI, ServiceNow and the Microsoft 365 suites.
* Self-motivated, organized, and highly capable of carrying out detailed plans with limited direction.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Collaborative and inclusive with a positive attitude, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams across geographical and organizational cultures and to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting data governance, access management, and IAM governance programs, with familiarity in RBAC concepts.
* Knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) or Oracle Database role and direct access permissions.
* Knowledge of SDLC, Agile, Scrum, or Kanban methodologies. PMP, Scrum, Agile, or Business Analysis certifications are a plus.
* Experience with ServiceNow workflow design and automation, Microsoft 365 collaboration tools (SharePoint, Planner, Power Automate), and Power BI data modeling and advanced visualization techniques.

title: Senior Business Execution Consultant [ISO 20022, Business Requirements, JIRA, Payments]
description:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Business Execution Consultant to support key business priorities within the Chief Operating Office. The role offers an opportunity to contribute to initiatives that strengthen execution discipline, operational excellence, risk management, and customer centricity. The Chief Operating Office focuses on strengthening Wells Fargo’s risk and control infrastructure while enabling consistent, effective, and efficient enterprise operations and services
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead and support business execution activities across multiple business groups and contribute to large-scale strategic initiatives
* Drive efficiency, quality, cost effectiveness, and effective pipeline management across assigned operations
* Research and analyze moderately complex business, operational, and strategic initiatives, applying knowledge of organizational strategy, business execution, and international business considerations
* Exercise independent judgment to identify business needs, develop recommendations, and provide guidance to support effective execution
* Support the planning and execution of programs and initiatives focused on risk mitigation, operational efficiency, and customer experience
* Collaborate and consult with business and functional leaders to develop and execute project plans, policies, and procedures
* Build and manage relationships with cross-functional business partners to support the successful implementation of programs, services, and initiatives

**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* Experience gathering, analyzing, and prioritizing business requirements and translating them into user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum environments, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and product delivery.
* Working knowledge of product and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Aha!, and Balsamiq.
* Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders, development, testing, and operations teams to deliver business or product initiatives.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
* 3–5 years of payments processing experience, including SWIFT MT/MX, Fedwire, CHIPS, ACH, RTP, or GPPSP, with knowledge of MX messages (Pacs, Pain, Camt, Admi) and MT N1/N2/N9 series.
* 3–5 years of business analysis experience, including gathering, analyzing, prioritizing, and translating business requirements into actionable deliverables.
* 3–5 years of experience working in Agile teams, with working knowledge of Jira and Confluence.
* Experience with payment reporting solutions and payment tracker applications, supporting operational and technology-driven payment initiatives.
* Strong verbal and written communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to respond quickly to issues and reprioritize work based on stakeholder and customer feedback.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience supporting payment transformation, modernization, or operational improvement initiatives within banking or financial services.
* Knowledge of payment operations, controls, risk management, and end-to-end payment processing across domestic or international payment channels.

**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Job Summary
  
  
As a Principal Engineer in our Identity Security division, you will be the ultimate technical authority and go-to expert for our core Single Sign-On (SSO) and Federation capabilities. You will own the architectural integrity, security posture, and scalability of our SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC) implementations. In this role, you will balance deep technical execution with organizational leadership—driving best practices across microservices, mentoring engineering teams, representing our identity expertise externally, and pioneering the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to advance our identity security capabilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Write clean, highly secure, and performance-optimized code for critical authentication paths and build Proof of Concepts (PoCs) to evaluate new architectures.
* Architect resilient, low-latency microservices capable of handling millions of token validations, federation requests, and authentication flows globally.
* Drive engineering modernizations, including upgrading backend frameworks, implementing secure CI/CD pipelines, and integrating advanced security analysis tools.
* Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of critical bugs involving multi-tenant SSO setups, token encryption/signing, and token lifecycles.
* Partner with data science teams to integrate AI/ML models into authentication flows for real-time risk scoring and anomalous token behavior detection.
* Advocate for and embed generative AI development tools into the team's daily workflows to safely accelerate delivery and improve code quality.
* Lead large-scale features, protocol refactors, and microservice optimizations, ensuring alignment with the company’s Tech Radar and security baselines.
* Identify architectural gaps in SSO services, advocate for improvements, and implement robust solutions.
* Conduct rigorous reviews of complex protocol implementations and cryptographic designs to ensure strict adherence to RFC standards.
* Proactively identify and resolve cross-team technical dependencies for seamless integration.
* Teach, guide, and upskill developers, fostering a culture of deep identity security awareness.
* Represent the company in the cybersecurity industry by speaking at tech conferences, writing technical blogs, or contributing to open-source identity standards.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record in a Tech Lead or Principal Engineer role.
* The candidate should have experience in at least one of the following programming languages: C#/.NET OR Java OR Python .The candidate should be willing to work with the C#/.NET technology stack.
* Exposure or strong interest in applying AI/ML technologies within cybersecurity contexts.
* Strong background in modern cloud-native architectures, distributed microservices, and secure-by-design engineering principles.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven experience in public speaking, technical writing (blogs/whitepapers), or mentoring engineering communities.
* Broad understanding of the business context, connecting technical decisions to customer value.
* Ability to translate highly complex technical concepts for both engineering and business stakeholders.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Identity and Access Management (IAM) architectures, specifically building and securing SAML 2.0 Identity/Service Providers and OAuth 2.0/OIDC Authorization Servers.

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Software Engineering Lead - Springboot, Python, Kubernetes, Docker, Mongo DB
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable software solutions using Java, Spring Boot, and Python. Build and optimize microservices and APIs using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and Kafka for high-throughput, event-driven architectures
* Leverage AWS and Google Cloud services to deliver secure, resilient, and cloud-native applications
* Implement containerization and orchestration strategies using Docker and Kubernetes
* Integrate MongoDB and Vault for data persistence and secure secrets management
* Apply AI/ML tools and APIs to enhance product intelligence and automation
* Utilize AI-powered development tools to streamline builds, testing, and productivity. Collaborate with Product Managers
* Designers, Data Scientists, and DevOps Engineers to translate business needs into technical solutions
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, contributing to continuous improvement
* Conduct code reviews and enforce best practices for code quality, security, and performance
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, ensuring system reliability and scalability
* Document system designs, technical decisions, and implementation details for knowledge sharing
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a culture of engineering excellence
* Adhere to company policies, employment terms, and evolving business directives, including team changes, work location flexibility, and shift adjustments.AI™, AI Agents, Blueprint, and Constellation UI enhancements
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field
* 7+ years of hands-on experience in software development
* Experience with MongoDB and secure secrets management using Vault
* Experience with modern development productivity tools, including AI-assisted coding platforms
* Experience with performance optimization, monitoring, and logging tools such as Splunk or Dynatrace
* Solid proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and Kafka for backend development
* Exposure to modern architectural patterns such as microservices, serverless computing, and event-driven architecture
* Knowledge in deploying and managing applications on cloud platforms
* Solid understanding of Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration for scalable deployments
* Familiarity with AI/ML tools and integrating them into SDLC
* Proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, or AI/ML integration
* Solid grasp of AI-DLC, Agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines
* Proven excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. Solid written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in healthcare domain and understanding of healthcare data and workflows
* Hands-on experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience in training team members
* Hand-on experience with AI productivity tools such Github Copilot
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, Infrastructure as Code, and tools like Jenkins, Terraform, Git, and GitHub Actions

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone - of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income - deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Sr. Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise-level customers.
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
  
  
Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
* Bachelor's degree in STEM field
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
* Experience in leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of delivering customer engagements in a professional services role experience
* active project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2)
* AWS certification
* Experience in delivering customer engagements in a professional services role
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Manager, Information Systems
description:
**Role Description**
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world.
  
  
The Manager, Information Systems will lead the Manufacturing Excellence product team responsible for delivering technology capabilities that improve business outcomes. This role will develop and lead a high-performing team, oversee technology delivery and operations, and ensure alignment with business strategy, enterprise standards, security, quality, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
The ideal candidate has strong leadership experience in technology-driven manufacturing or regulated environments, combined with knowledge of software delivery, product management, organizational transformation, and global team leadership.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop a diverse technology team within a global, matrixed organization.
* Build a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, mentor, coach, and develop talent while promoting inclusive and effective ways of working.
* Maintain strong relationships with business and technology leaders and communicate service roadmaps, delivery status, risks, and priorities.
* Understand business processes, manufacturing workflows, and information needs and translate them into technology capabilities and measurable outcomes.
* Develop and execute technology, product, and workforce plans aligned with organizational strategy.
* Oversee the software-development lifecycle, including planning, design, delivery, deployment, operations, and support.
* Work with product owners, service owners, architects, delivery teams, and vendors to ensure commitments are met.
* Manage scope, schedules, risks, dependencies, resources, and escalations across technology initiatives.
* Promote Agile, DevOps, automation, cloud, data, analytics, and AI capabilities where they provide business value.
* Ensure technology solutions comply with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, quality, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
* Define and monitor performance metrics for delivery, reliability, service quality, adoption, and business outcomes.
* Manage operating and product-team budgets, forecasts, vendor costs, and resource plans.
* Participate in leadership, governance, and stakeholder meetings and facilitate cross-functional alignment.
* Support change management and adoption of new technology products, processes, and ways of working.
* Remain accountable for overall organizational compliance with applicable quality and regulatory requirements.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 8–12 years of experience in Business, Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Demonstrated experience leading technology initiatives, products, services, and teams.
* Experience managing, coaching, and developing employees and matrixed teams.
* Strong experience partnering with business leaders, product owners, and senior stakeholders.
* Experience defining technology roadmaps, operating models, and delivery plans.
* Strong understanding of software development, product management, Agile delivery, DevOps, and production operations.
* Experience managing scope, budgets, risks, vendors, resources, and executive escalations.
* Experience with technology governance, cybersecurity, quality, compliance, and risk management.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, manufacturing, life sciences, or another regulated industry.
* Strong business acumen, analytical thinking, decision-making, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Experience applying methodologies such as Agile, SAFe, Kanban, ITIL, or comparable frameworks.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively with global and virtual teams.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Leadership experience within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, manufacturing, or technology organization.
* Experience leading software, cloud, data, analytics, automation, or AI-enabled product teams.
* Broad knowledge of enterprise applications, architecture, infrastructure, data, integration, cybersecurity, and cloud platforms.
* Experience managing strategic vendors, consulting firms, or managed-service providers.
* Understanding of manufacturing systems, enterprise data platforms, and regulated computerized systems.
* Experience with organizational transformation, change management, and product operating models.

**Preferred Certifications**

* ITIL certification — preferred.
* Agile or Scaled Agile Framework certification — preferred.
* Product, project, program, cloud, or change-management certification — preferred.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent leadership, coaching, and team-management skills.
* Strong transformation and change-management capabilities.
* Exceptional communication, collaboration, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* High degree of initiative, ownership, and accountability.
* Ability to influence decisions and build trusted partnerships.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global, and matrixed environment.

title: Staff Engineer, Software
description:
**Work Schedule**
First Shift (Days)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Office
  
  
Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. (NYSE: TMO) is the world leader in serving science, with revenues of more than $20 billion and approximately 65,000 employees globally. Our mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We help our customers accelerate life sciences research, solve complex analytical challenges, improve patient diagnostics, deliver medicines to market and increase laboratory productivity. Through our premier brands – Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific and Unity Lab Services – we offer an unmatched combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and comprehensive services
  
  
**The Position**
We are seeking a Lead DevOps Engineer to design, implement, and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines and automation frameworks supporting software development and delivery processes. This role focuses on enabling efficient, reliable, and scalable build and release workflows, particularly within C#/.NET environments.
  
  
You will work in a collaborative, cross-functional environment, partnering with development, QA, test automation, and infrastructure teams to streamline software delivery, improve system reliability, and support continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
  
  
**Key responsibilities**
include, but are not exclusively:
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins and GitLab to support automated build, test, and deployment processes
* Support and optimize C#/.NET/Angular build and deployment workflows, including management of NuGet packages
* Implement and maintain version control strategies using Git, including branching and merging approaches aligned with release processes
* Manage release activities, including maintaining stabilization branches and ensuring smooth release cycles
* Develop and maintain automation scripts using Python and PowerShell to improve operational efficiency
* Design and support containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes for scalable application deployment
* Implement advanced deployment strategies such as Blue-Green deployments to ensure minimal downtime and risk
* Ensure integration of static code analysis tools (e.g., SonarQube, TICS) and multiple automated test suites within CI pipelines
* Maintain end-to-end pipeline flow, from environment provisioning and build execution to artifact storage and archival
* Collaborate with development, QA, and test automation teams to translate requirements into technical solutions and pipeline designs
* Work closely with shared infrastructure teams (e.g., SETI, Toolchain teams) to align infrastructure standards and best practices
* Contribute to and maintain documentation using Confluence, ensuring knowledge sharing and transparency across teams
* Utilize Jira for backlog tracking, sprint planning, and progress monitoring within Agile frameworks
* Actively participate in Scrum, Kanban, and scaled Agile (ART) environments, contributing to continuous delivery practices
* Collaborate with cross-ART teams (e.g., CI/CD and Test Automation teams) to align on shared tools, frameworks, and codebases
* Leading and mentoring junior DevOps resources within the team.
* Apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills to troubleshoot complex issues and improve system performance and reliability

**Requirements:**
The ideal candidate for this position thrives in a complex technical environment and is passionate about automation, continuous integration, and delivering high-quality software solutions.
  
  

* University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline
* Strong hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins and GitLab, including designing and maintaining automation pipelines
* 8+ years of Strong Experience in supporting C#/.NET/Angular build and deployment processes
* Solid knowledge of package management, especially NuGet
* Strong experience with Git and modern branching strategies
* Experience in release management, including maintaining stabilization branches and coordinating releases
* Hands-on scripting and automation experience using Python and/or PowerShell
* Proven experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes
* Experience in implementing modern deployment strategies such as Blue-Green deployments
* Strong understanding of VMware infrastructure and security best practices
* Experience in integrating static code analysis tools (e.g., SonarQube, TICS) into CI/CD pipelines
* Experience in integrating and managing multiple automated test suites within CI pipelines
* Understanding of end-to-end pipeline processes, from environment setup to artifact management and archival
* Hands-on experience with Jira for backlog management and sprint tracking
* Experience in working within Agile frameworks such as Scrum and Kanban
* Familiarity with Agile Release Trains (ART) and scaled Agile environments
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues
* Proven ability to deliver solutions in complex technical environments
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with development, QA, test automation, and infrastructure teams
* Experience collaborating with shared infrastructure teams (e.g., SETI, Toolchain teams) and cross-ART teams
* Optimize infrastructure resource utilization to ensure high performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Monitor and identify performance bottlenecks and implement improvements.
* Fluent in English (B2 level or higher)
* Eligible for travel if required

title: Specialist Scrum Master - DTI Marketing
description:
The Specialist Scrum Master serves as a servant leader and Agile coach for one or more Scrum teams. This role is responsible for enabling high-performing teams through effective facilitation, coaching, impediment removal, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence. The Specialist Scrum Master partners closely with Product Owners, Engineering Leads, Architects, and business stakeholders to maximise value delivery and accelerate Agile maturity.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Agile Leadership & Coaching
  
  

* Coach teams on Scrum principles, Agile practices, and servant leadership.

* Help teams mature in Agile delivery practices and product thinking.
* Facilitate conflict resolution and promote psychological safety.

Scrum Facilitation
  
  

* Facilitate Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, Refinements, and Retrospectives.

Impediment Management
  
  

* Identify, track, and facilitate removal of team and organisational blockers.

* Monitor Sprint health, team velocity, predictability, and flow metrics.

* Partner with Product Owners to maintain a healthy, prioritised backlog.

* Lead meaningful retrospectives resulting in actionable improvements.
* Drive process optimisation initiatives across teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in Agile environments.
* 3+ years of experience as a Scrum Master supporting software delivery teams.
* Deep understanding of Scrum, Kanban, Lean, and Agile methodologies.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent Agile tools.
* Strong facilitation, coaching, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), or equivalent certification.
* Experience supporting multiple Scrum teams.
* Experience in scaled Agile environments (SAFe, LeSS, Nexus).
* Knowledge of Agile metrics, flow efficiency, and Lean product delivery

Success Measures
  
  

* Improved sprint predictability and delivery reliability.
* Reduced delivery impediments and cycle time.
* Increased team engagement and Agile maturity.
* High stakeholder satisfaction.
* Continuous improvement actions implemented and sustained

* Support release readiness activities and production validation testing.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives.

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

We are known as well-known org Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. title: Scrum Master/BA III, Commercialization
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Assignment Summary**
The Scrum Master / Business Analyst III partners directly with the hiring manager to establish the agile operating model for assigned teams within Commercial Data & AI, working with program managers to embed consistent agile ways of working and automating operational and delivery metrics reporting. The assignment is accountable for sprint health and delivery predictability, while maintaining lightweight requirements and backlog continuity for assigned teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner directly with the hiring manager to define and establish the team's agile operating model — ceremonies, cadences, roles, and ways of working — for assigned teams within Commercial Data & AI.
* Work with program managers across Commercial Data & AI to establish and embed consistent agile ways of working, aligning practices and standards across teams.
* Automate operational and delivery metrics reporting — velocity, capacity, throughput, predictability, risks, and dependencies — turning raw delivery data into a reliable, self-updating leadership narrative.
* Automate recurring coordination activities such as status reporting, dashboard updates, ceremony preparation, dependency tracking, and routine follow-ups using approved AI and automation tools.
* Own Agile delivery governance for assigned teams, including sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, and cross-functional ceremonies, with accountability for team health and delivery predictability.
* Actively coach assigned teams on Agile principles and practices, building durable agile maturity rather than simply running ceremonies.
* Apply automation to routine backlog hygiene, traceability updates, and status tracking to reduce manual overhead and improve consistency.
* Apply established Jira and Confluence standards for assigned teams, including board configuration, workflows, permissions, dashboards, and documentation.
* Identify and drive resolution of impediments, risks, and cross-team dependencies before they affect delivery timelines or quality.
* Oversee vendor delivery quality and adherence to agreed ways of working for vendor-staffed capacity supporting assigned teams, escalating material gaps through the appropriate BMS owner.
* Maintain lightweight ownership of requirements quality for assigned teams — user stories, acceptance criteria, and backlog traceability — sufficient to keep backlog items build-ready.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Experience partnering directly with a hiring manager or delivery lead to stand up or significantly reshape a team's agile operating model, not only operating within an existing one.
* Experience working with program managers to establish or harmonize agile ways of working across multiple teams.
* Hands-on experience automating operational and delivery metrics reporting (velocity, capacity, throughput, predictability) using approved AI or automation tools.
* Strong knowledge of Agile delivery frameworks such as Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or equivalent, with a demonstrated ability to build agile maturity in a team, not just facilitate ceremonies.
* Advanced Jira proficiency and working Confluence proficiency, including workflows, dashboards, permissions, and documentation standards.
* Solid requirements and backlog-quality fundamentals — user stories, acceptance criteria, traceability — sufficient to keep delivery moving without deep domain ownership.
* Ability to translate delivery data into clear updates for domain stakeholders, technical teams, and senior leadership.
* Facilitation, coaching, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills across global, matrixed teams, including vendor-supported delivery models.
* Ability to onboard quickly, work independently, navigate ambiguity, and deliver effectively in a time-bound contingent assignment.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. An MBA or equivalent advanced degree is preferred.
* 7+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Business Analyst, Agile Delivery Lead, or similar role, ideally with a track record of establishing agile operating models and automating delivery coordination, not only running ceremonies.
* Experience partnering with program managers or portfolio leads to align agile practices and ways of working across teams.
* Experience working with vendor-supported delivery capacity and maintaining adherence to team standards and expected outcomes.
* Experience working across US, India, and other global locations in Agile or product-based delivery environments.

title: Technical Delivery Manager
description:
**Aptagrim**
designs, engineers and deploys specialised enterprise AI products and intelligent workflow systems. Our systems are built around how a business actually works: its knowledge, its decisions and its day-to-day operations.

We are a growing team at an early stage. You will shape how we deliver, not just follow an existing playbook, and the AI systems you ship will run inside real enterprise operations.

**The role**

We're hiring a hands-on
**Technical Delivery Manager**
with deep Python and Django experience. You will own the delivery of enterprise applications and AI solutions, from discovery to production rollout.

This is a technical leadership role, not a task-tracking one. Expect to spend about 25–30% of your time hands-on: reviewing code, designing backend systems, unblocking engineers and building critical pieces or proofs of concept yourself. The rest goes to delivery ownership, client relationships, planning and team leadership.

**What you'll do**

**Delivery ownership**

* Own delivery end to end: lead discovery, scoping, estimation, planning, build, testing, client acceptance, deployment and handover to support.
* Plan realistically: set milestones, dependencies and acceptance criteria that account for technical uncertainty, data readiness and client inputs. Spot risks early and act on them.
* Control scope and economics: assess the effort, schedule and commercial impact of change requests. Track utilisation, budgets and project margins, and correct course when they drift.
* Run multiple engagements: balance engineering, QA, DevOps and business analysis capacity across projects, working with the Project Coordinator on tracking and reporting.

**Technical leadership**

* Lead backend engineering: guide the design of scalable, secure and maintainable systems in Python, Django and Django REST Framework, including APIs, data models, background processing and enterprise integrations.
* Stay hands-on: review code, debug hard production and performance issues, and build critical components or proofs of concept when the team needs it.
* Integrate AI into products: work with the Head of AI's team to bring LLM, retrieval and agent capabilities into production applications, with sound data flows, failure handling and monitoring.
* Set the quality bar: establish practical standards for testing, code review, documentation, security, observability and release readiness, and own production readiness: deployment, rollback, monitoring and incident response.

**Clients and team**

* Own client communication: run delivery reviews, explain technical trade-offs in plain language, set expectations (including around AI accuracy and iteration) and resolve escalations.
* Support pre-sales: turn business requirements into solution options, estimates, assumptions and statements of work.
* Grow the team: mentor engineers and tech leads, help hire, delegate well, and use retrospectives to make estimates and delivery steadily more predictable.

**What you'll bring**

* 7+ years in software engineering, including at least 3 years in technical leadership with ownership of client-facing delivery.
* Deep, recent, hands-on Python and Django: Django REST Framework, object-oriented design, application architecture and production troubleshooting. You still write and review code regularly.
* Strong backend fundamentals: REST API design, authentication and role-based access, PostgreSQL (schema design, ORM, indexing, query tuning, migrations), and async processing with task queues and caching (for example, Celery and Redis).
* Production engineering: testing, Git workflows, CI/CD, Docker, Linux and deployment on a major cloud, plus security, secrets management, logging, monitoring and incident investigation.
* A track record of delivering enterprise applications from requirements through deployment and client acceptance.
* Delivery and commercial skills: estimation, planning, risk and scope management, effort forecasting, and managing budgets and margins.
* Clear communication: you can explain technical problems to non-technical stakeholders and handle difficult client conversations calmly.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery, applied pragmatically rather than by the book.

**Nice to have**

* Experience shipping LLM-based features to production, such as RAG pipelines, agent workflows, prompt and output evaluation, or LLM API integration
* Experience delivering projects where data quality, model accuracy or non-deterministic outputs shaped the plan
* Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure services beyond basic deployment

* Lead and coach a team across backend, frontend, cloud, DevOps, production support, and release validation responsibilities.
