title: Supervisor, Applications Delivery
description:
**Job Description**
 The person in this role is responsible for leading the design, delivery, implementation, and ongoing support of high\-quality application solutions. At lead/manager level, the role is accountable not only for technical execution, but also for delivery ownership, team coordination, stakeholder alignment, quality governance, operational stability, and continuous improvement across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
   

  

 The person in this role works closely with business stakeholders, architects, project managers, vendors, and cross\-functional delivery teams to translate business priorities into scalable, secure, maintainable, and business\-aligned technology solutions. The role is expected to provide technical leadership, guide team members, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure successful delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Leadership, Requirements Analysis \& Estimation**
* Lead requirement analysis discussions with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and delivery teams.
* Translate business, functional, and non\-functional requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery plan, and implementation priorities.
* Own or review effort estimation, delivery planning, resource requirements, and execution timelines for assigned initiatives.
* Identify delivery risks, dependencies, assumptions, and constraints, and drive mitigation plans with stakeholders.
* Ensure requirement documents, user stories, solution notes, and technical specifications are complete, clear, and aligned with agreed scope.


**Solution Design**
* Provide technical leadership in converting enterprise architecture and business needs into detailed solution designs and implementation plans.
* Review and approve design artifacts, workflows, integration approaches, technical specifications, and solution documentation.
* Evaluate design alternatives and guide the team toward scalable, secure, high\-performing, maintainable, and cost\-effective solutions.
* Ensure solution designs comply with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, data governance expectations, and engineering best practices.
* Lead technical discussions and design reviews with architects, vendors, project teams, and support teams.


**Application Development**
* Lead and guide application development, enhancement, configuration, integration, and maintenance activities.
* Review key technical deliverables to ensure quality, maintainability, performance, security, and alignment with agreed standards.
* Provide technical direction to developers and support team members, including code review guidance, design clarification, and issue resolution support.
* Drive reuse of components, utilities, frameworks, and automation capabilities to improve delivery efficiency and consistency.
* Balance hands\-on technical contribution with oversight of team delivery, ensuring work is completed on time and with expected quality.


**Testing \& Quality Assurance**
* Define and oversee testing strategy, test coverage, quality checkpoints, and defect management for assigned solutions.
* Ensure unit, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing activities are planned and executed effectively.
* Review high\-impact defects, support root cause analysis, and ensure corrective actions are implemented before production release.
* Promote test automation, continuous quality improvement, and proactive quality assurance practices across the delivery team.
* Ensure solutions meet functional, non\-functional, compliance, and operational readiness expectations before deployment.


**Architecture \& Technical Governance**
* Lead or actively govern application architecture, technical design, and solution review activities for assigned applications or projects.
* Ensure delivery teams follow architectural guidelines, technology standards, security policies, coding standards, and documentation expectations.
* Participate in governance forums and provide clear recommendations on solution risks, trade\-offs, dependencies, and mitigation options.
* Drive technical decision\-making in alignment with enterprise architecture, business priorities, operational impact, and long\-term maintainability.


**Release, Deployment \& Implementation**
* Own or coordinate release planning, environment readiness, deployment preparation, and implementation activities.
* Manage release risks, change approvals, production validation, rollback planning, and go\-live readiness with project and support teams.
* Coordinate application rollouts, stakeholder communication, hypercare planning, and post\-deployment stabilization.
* Ensure project is completed with proper documentation, monitoring, support handover, and minimal operational risk.


**Production Support \& Maintenance**
* Lead production support coordination for assigned applications, including incident triage, escalation, stakeholder communication, and service restoration.
* Review critical incidents, drive root cause analysis, and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Monitor application stability, performance, SLA adherence, operational risks, and recurring issue patterns.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, vendors, business users, and support teams to resolve issues within agreed timelines.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce recurring incidents, improve support efficiency, and strengthen operational resilience.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as a primary point of contact for business stakeholders, customers, vendors, project managers, and support teams for assigned applications or delivery scope.
* Facilitate effective communication between business and IT teams, ensuring expectations, priorities, risks, and decisions are clearly understood.
* Provide timely, accurate, and management\-ready updates on project progress, production issues, risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
* Lead stakeholder workshops, solution walkthroughs, demonstrations, implementation discussions, and operational readiness reviews.
* Build trusted relationships by demonstrating ownership, responsiveness, business understanding, technical credibility, and accountability.


**People Management \& Team Leadership**
* Lead, guide, mentor, and support developers, analysts, and support team members across project and operational activities.
* Allocate work, monitor progress, remove blockers, and ensure team deliverables meet agreed scope, timeline, and quality standards.
* Identify capability gaps, provide coaching, support knowledge transfer, and recommend training or development actions.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Coordinate with internal teams and vendor resources to ensure effective delivery performance and service continuity.


**Knowledge Management \& Organizational Learning**
* Own and maintain technical documentation, solution design records, support guides, runbooks, lessons learned, and reusable delivery assets.
* Establish knowledge\-sharing practices across project, development, and support teams to reduce dependency on individuals.
* Leverage lessons learned from previous projects and production issues to improve delivery effectiveness, solution quality, and operational stability.
* Conduct knowledge transfer sessions, mentor team members, and ensure transition readiness for support and maintenance teams.
* Promote continuous learning, technical capability development, and standardization across applications and technology domains.


**Transition \& Service Readiness**
* Own transition planning and service readiness for new or enhanced applications moving into production support.
* Ensure operational documentation, support guides, monitoring requirements, escalation paths, and handover materials are complete.
* Lead knowledge transfer sessions for support, maintenance, operations, and vendor teams.
* Confirm service readiness before production transition, including support model, SLA expectations, issue ownership, and operational acceptance criteria.


**Qualifications**
**Technical Skills**
* Programming in MS Visual C\#, Dot Net Framework
* Programming in RESTful API
* Coding SQL for Sql Server


**Software Engineering Processes**
* Strong working knowledge of SDLC methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models.
* Ability to lead delivery planning, sprint or milestone tracking, dependency management, issue resolution, and delivery governance.
* Experience establishing or enforcing engineering practices, documentation standards, quality gates, and release readiness controls.


**Design Knowledge**
* Strong understanding of architecture principles, integration patterns, design methodologies, design patterns, and anti\-patterns.
* Ability to review architectural requirements and guide teams in developing scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable technical designs.
* Experience assessing technical trade\-offs, long\-term maintainability, operational impact, and business value when recommending solutions.


**Requirements Engineering**
* Strong experience in requirements elicitation, analysis, prioritization, documentation, traceability, and stakeholder validation.
* Ability to translate business requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery roadmap, and operational support model.
* Experience managing requirement changes, business expectations, scope control, and impact assessment across project delivery phases.


**Configuration \& Release Management**
* Strong knowledge of source control, configuration management, environment management, release governance, and deployment processes.
* Experience coordinating CI/CD, build automation, deployment validation, version control, and rollback planning.
* Ability to manage release dependencies, approvals, production readiness, and post\-release stabilization activities.


**Build \& Testing Practices**
* Strong understanding of build tools, development frameworks, automation techniques, and quality engineering practices.
* Experience defining test strategy, reviewing test coverage, supporting test automation, and managing defect resolution.
* Ability to ensure software quality through structured testing, quality checkpoints, and production readiness validation.


**Behavioral Competencies**
**Analytical Thinking**
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to evaluate technical, operational, financial, and business impacts from multiple sources before recommending actions.
* Capable of assessing alternatives, facilitating alignment, and driving practical solutions under time, cost, and operational constraints.


**Communication**
* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to communicate technical or complex topics clearly in business terms for management, business users, vendors, and technical teams.
* Able to prepare clear status updates, escalation notes, decision papers, meeting summaries, and management\-ready communications.


**Planning \& Organization**
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, resources, and operational demands in a dynamic environment.
* Proactively identifies risks, dependencies, constraints, and execution challenges, and drives mitigation with relevant stakeholders.
* Effective in planning, tracking, organizing, and coordinating deliverables across project phases, support activities, vendors, and cross\-functional teams.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Works effectively with senior stakeholders, cross\-functional teams, vendors, business users, and technical teams.
* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, customer focus, business understanding, and delivery discipline.
* Builds trust through transparency, responsiveness, sound judgment, and consistent follow\-through on commitments.


 Supports a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and team development.
   

  

**Working Experience**
* Over 8 years of relevant IT experience, including experience in application delivery, technical leadership, stakeholder management, production support, vendor coordination and team management. Prior lead or manager\-level experience is preferred.

 We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production\-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services.

 We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs.
 

  
 




  
 



**About the role:** 





 We are seeking an experienced and hands\-on 
 
**Senior Application QA**

  to join our growing Quality Engineering team supporting a major UK Financial Services client.

 Quality Engineering \& Test Strategy

* environments.

 Defect Management

* Perform root cause analysis alongside development teams.


* Validate defect fixes and regression impacts.


* Ensure defects contain sufficient evidence for efficient investigation.


* Monitor defect trends and recommend process improvements.

* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.


* Support continuous testing practices.

* Support release validation activities.


* Help improve deployment quality through automation.





 Production \& Release Support
 


  
 



* Participate in release readiness activities.


* Perform post\-deployment validation.


* Support investigation of production incidents.

 Test Data \& Environment Management
 


  
 



* Prepare and maintain appropriate test data.


* Coordinate environment readiness for testing activities.


* Support environment troubleshooting.


* Ensure data integrity throughout testing.

 Support and contribute to:
 

  
 



* Performance Testing


* Load Testing


* Accessibility Testing


* Compatibility Testing


* Security Testing




 Working alongside specialist teams where required.
 

  
 






 Agile Delivery
 


  
 



* Actively participate in Agile ceremonies.


* Collaborate with cross\-functional delivery teams.


* Provide regular updates on testing progress and quality risks.


* Promote quality ownership across the delivery team.





 Continuous Improvement
 


  
 



* Recommend improvements to testing processes, tools and frameworks.


* Contribute to QA standards and documentation.


* Mentor junior QA engineers.


* Share knowledge and best practices across the team.


* Promote a quality\-first engineering culture.



**Required Skills \& Experience**




***Essential***



* 5\+ years of experience in Software Testing or Quality Engineering.

 The Position
   

  

**Job Description**
**The Delivery Management Professional \- Scrum Master (SE6\) leads moderately complex deliveries, proactively identifies improvements, manages diverse stakeholders, and contributes to strategic implementation. In this role, you will independently define and control the scope of medium to large initiatives, utilizing effective facilitation and analytical skills to drive value delivery. While navigating intricate stakeholder environments, you will connect team development with broader business objectives. Depending on the organization's needs, you may operate within role archetypes such as Project Manager, Service (Delivery) Manager, ITSM Process SME, Scrum Master, RTE, or Agile Coach.**

**The Clinical Submission Data and Content Generation \& Reuse function focuses on modernizing the creation and management of clinical data and regulatory submission assets (data and content). It develops and deploys platforms for structured content management, enabling the reuse of approved components across documents. This group also pioneers the use of agentic AI to assist in generating, reviewing, and assembling complex submission assets (data and content), aiming to improve quality and reduce authoring timelines.**

* Champions the adoption of scope management best practices

****Accountability \& Problem Solving****

****Complexity \& Product Size Management****

title: Scrum Master - Senior Engineer
description:
TJX Companies
   

  

 At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off\-price retailer.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About TJX:**
 TJX is a Fortune 100 company that operates off\-price retailers of apparel and home fashions. TJX India \- Hyderabad is the IT home office in the global technology organization of off\-price apparel and home fashion retailer TJX, established to deliver innovative solutions that help transform operations globally. At TJX, we strive to build a workplace where our Associates’ contributions are welcomed and are embedded in our purpose to provide excellent value to our customers every day. At TJX India, we take a long\-term view of your career. We have a high\-performance culture that rewards Associates with career growth opportunities, preferred assignments, and upward career advancement. We take well\-being very seriously and are committed to offering a great work\-life balance for all our Associates.
   

  

**What You Will Discover**
* Inclusive culture and career growth opportunities
* A truly Global IT Organization that collaborates across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia, click here to learn more
* Challenging, collaborative, and team\-based environment


**Our Organization**
 The Global Stores Engineering organization is responsible for delivering technology solutions to drive growth, enable efficiency, and improve the customer experience at the front\-line in our stores. We innovate globally across all TJX banners to ensure a first\-class transaction process for our customers (sales, returns, and exchanges), enable payment processing and TJX rewards programs, facilitate downstream sales audit and financial reporting, and much more!
   

  

 We are on a mission to modernize our solutions, which include extending our solutions globally and exploring alternative and mobile checkout solutions. We aspire to align with our global partners to deliver high value products and streamlined experiences to our customers and associates. Our commitment is to lead the way, empowering our team to drive efficiencies, grow skills, and deliver great solutions.
   

  

 We are expanding our organizational footprint and need your help to accomplish our vision! You will have a real opportunity to be a part of driving over $50B in annual revenue and make our stores a destination that our customers love.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 This Scrum Master role will support our Stores \& Supply Chain Engineering Teams from India. As a Scrum Master, in an Agile/iterative team you will be responsible for educating and coaching your Scrum/Kanban team(s) on GFOS Agile / Iterative processes. You will also be responsible for leading continuous improvement initiatives within your team and display a working knowledge of Kanban, Scrum and Iterative principles. Supporting impediment removals, fostering an environment that builds and supports a high performing team and monitoring team progress are key functions or this role.
   

  

 You will partner with the Product Owner and Product Manager (who in India may be Product, Delivery and or Engineering associates) to ensure the product backlog is continuously refined and work is prioritized and scheduled. The Scrum Master is accountable for delivering value to the business and stakeholders. Understanding and supporting the TJX Solution Delivery Process (SDP) while adhering to Compliance guidelines is key.
   

  

 The following are examples of typical Scrum Master activities.
   

  

* Supports team impediment removal and dependency tracking
* Facilitates Agile team ceremonies e.g., daily standups, reviews, retrospectives
* Ensures team agreements are in place
* Drives team iteration commitments and plan to maximize business value delivery
* Collaborates with other Scrum Masters across the ART as necessary e.g., Scrum of Scrums
* Coordinates with other teams as necessary, for example Shared Services or DevOps team
* Key Partner with the Product Owner to ensure product backlog items are refined, prioritized, and scheduled
* Supports estimating activities within the team
* Supports Release Planning
* Responsible for facilitating capacity planning
* Reviews metrics to measure team progress and responsible for achieving baseline KPI
* Validates time tracking
* Tracks team objectives using appropriate Agile tools/applications
* Protects team from external interference
* Supports ART Readiness/Preparations
* May provide Flow Board Management if supporting a Kanban team
* May be an Epic Owner


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Over 5 years of experience working in Agile environments, with a strong focus on iterative delivery and continuous improvement
* 4\+ years serving as a Scrum Master, guiding teams through Agile transformation and execution
* Advanced Scrum certification (PSM II or CSP), demonstrating deep understanding of Agile principles and practices
* Expertise in Agile delivery models, including Scrum and Kanban
* Proficient in story structuring and sizing, defining "Definition of Done," facilitating Agile ceremonies, and driving effective sprint execution
* Proven ability to coach and support multiple teams simultaneously, fostering collaboration and high performance
* Exceptional facilitation and conflict resolution skills, enabling productive team dynamics and stakeholder engagement
* Experienced in estimation and budgeting, supporting planning and forecasting across initiatives
* Clear and transparent communicator, adept at aligning teams and stakeholders through concise messaging
* Empathetic leadership style, supporting and motivating teams through challenges and change
* Strong problem\-solving capabilities, focused on removing impediments and maintaining team momentum
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Understanding of retail operations, in\-store technologies, and omnichannel commerce
* SAFE Agile Certifications are a plus.


 In addition to our open door policy and supportive work environment, we also strive to provide a competitive salary and benefits package. TJX considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity and expression, marital or military status, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. TJX also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state and local law.

title: Senior Manager, Agile Transformation, Commercial Ops
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Agile Transformation Leader will be accountable for driving measurable business outcomes through Agile transformation, scaled execution, and continuous improvement across CCFT. This role will ensure that CCFT staff, product teams, Agile Release Trains, and leaders effectively leverage SAFe practices, Agile governance, product delivery disciplines, and performance metrics to improve speed, quality, predictability, customer value, and strategic alignment.
   

  

 This role will serve as a senior transformation leader, coach, people leader, and change agent focused on translating Agile ways of working into tangible business impact. The Agile Transformation Leader will partner closely with CCFT leadership, Agile Enablement, product teams, and global stakeholders to improve delivery effectiveness, strengthen execution accountability, and build a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous value delivery.
   

  

 AIN Scrum Masters within CCFT will report directly to this role, and SM across geographies will have a dotted line of reporting.
   

  

**Key Roles And Responsibilities**
**Business Outcome\-Driven Agile Transformation**
* Lead Agile transformation across CCFT with a clear focus on improving business outcomes, delivery predictability, product value, stakeholder satisfaction, operational efficiency, and time\-to\-market.
* Assess Agile maturity across teams and Agile Release Trains to identify opportunities that directly improve execution, flow, quality, transparency, and value realization.
* Develop and implement Agile maturity accelerators that help teams move beyond process adoption toward measurable improvements in delivery performance and business impact.
* Partner with CCFT leadership to align Agile practices, team priorities, and product execution with strategic business objectives.
* Drive transformation initiatives that improve how CCFT plans, funds, prioritizes, delivers, measures, and continuously improves product and technology outcomes.
* Strengthen our operation and execution excellence by focusing on Incident Management and Live narratives across product teams within Commercial Tech.


**People Leadership and Agile Capability Building**
* Provide direct management, leadership, and mentorship to Scrum Masters/BA, ensuring their work is aligned to business priorities, team outcomes, and Agile delivery excellence.
* Shortlist, interview, hire, onboard, and develop Scrum Masters who can enable high\-performing teams and improve delivery outcomes.
* Mentor Scrum Masters, Release Train Engineers, Product Analysts, and Product Managers to strengthen Agile execution, product thinking, stakeholder alignment, and outcome\-based delivery.
* Establish clear expectations for Agile roles with an emphasis on value delivery, impediment removal, decision enablement, and continuous improvement.
* Support performance development for Agile delivery roles by connecting individual contributions to team maturity, product outcomes, and organizational goals.


**Coaching, Mentoring, and Enablement**
* Coach Global CCFT teams and leaders on applying SAFe, Agile, Lean, and product management practices in ways that improve business agility and execution effectiveness.
* Provide practical guidance to teams on Agile events, roles, planning, prioritization, dependency management, and delivery practices that support better business outcomes.
* Deliver training, enablement sessions, and workshops that help teams, leaders, and stakeholders understand how Agile practices enable faster decisions, better alignment, improved quality, and increased value delivery.
* Facilitate workshops focused on outcome\-based planning, product alignment, Agile governance, continuous improvement, and SAFe adoption.
* Promote shared learning across teams to scale proven practices and improve Agile capability across CCFT globally.


**Agile Governance, Metrics, and Value Measurement**
* Enable Agile governance practices that improve transparency, accountability, decision\-making, and business alignment across CCFT product teams and Agile Release Trains.
* Establish and promote the use of meaningful Agile and product metrics to measure delivery health, predictability, flow, quality, risk, dependencies, customer value, and business impact.
* Help teams and leaders use metrics to make better decisions, identify improvement opportunities, and demonstrate progress against strategic objectives.
* Conduct regular program reviews with stakeholders to provide visibility into delivery progress, risks, dependencies, value delivered, and outcomes achieved.
* Ensure Agile measurement practices are used to drive learning, prioritization, and continuous improvement rather than solely administrative reporting.


**Continuous Improvement and Innovation**
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, collaboration, accountability, and measurable value delivery across CCFT.
* Identify systemic delivery impediments and partner with leaders and teams to remove barriers that limit speed, quality, predictability, or business value.
* Drive improvements in planning, execution, feedback loops, prioritization, dependency management, and stakeholder engagement.
* Develop reusable accelerators, playbooks, coaching models, and operating practices that improve Agile maturity and business effectiveness.
* Encourage experimentation and learning to help teams improve delivery outcomes and respond more effectively to changing business needs.


**Agile Transformation Leadership and Stakeholder Engagement**
* Act as a change agent by promoting the business value of SAFe, Agile ways of working, DPOM, and product\-oriented delivery.
* Collaborate with leaders, stakeholders, and business partners to build shared understanding of how Agile transformation supports CCFT’s strategic goals and business outcomes.
* Help teams and stakeholders overcome resistance to change by clearly connecting new ways of working to improved delivery, stronger alignment, and better outcomes.
* Build strong partnerships with the Agile Enablement team to scale knowledge sharing, accelerate capability development, and improve organizational Agile maturity.
* Participate in stakeholder and leadership meetings to communicate transformation progress, business impact, risks, recommendations, and improvement opportunities.


**Program Execution and Delivery Accountability**
* Support efficient program execution across CCFT by helping teams improve planning discipline, dependency management, risk management, decision\-making, and delivery accountability.
* Partner with Scrum Masters, RTEs, Product Analysts, Product Managers, and stakeholders to improve team performance and ensure execution remains aligned with business priorities.
* Help teams understand stakeholder needs, decision\-making workflows, business processes, and information requirements to improve delivery relevance and business value.
* Collaborate with geographically dispersed teams, including teams in the United States and international locations, to improve consistency, transparency, and delivery outcomes.
* Ensure Agile delivery practices support product strategy, business objectives, operational excellence, and enterprise priorities.


**Must\-Have Skills**
**Required Functional Skills and Qualifications**
* 12 \-17 years of experience managing, mentoring, and developing Scrum Masters, Release Train Engineers, Product Analysts, or Product Managers.
* Direct hands\-on experience with Agile and product software delivery in roles such as Scrum Master, Release Train Engineer, Product Owner or Product Manager, Agile Coach, or SAFe Practice Consultant.
* Proven experience leading Agile transformations that delivered measurable improvements in delivery performance, team maturity, stakeholder alignment, or business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of SAFe principles, Agile delivery practices, Lean\-Agile mindset, Agile governance, product management, and continuous improvement methods.
* Experience facilitating Agile training, workshops, coaching sessions, transformation planning, and outcome\-based improvement initiatives.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence leaders and teams at all levels.
* Experience collaborating with global and geographically dispersed teams.
* Ability to connect Agile practices with business objectives, product outcomes, stakeholder value, and enterprise priorities.
* Ability to foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, continuous improvement, and measurable value delivery.


**Preferred Experience**

* Experience supporting Agile Release Trains, PI Planning, Inspect and Adapt events, ART execution, and Agile program or portfolio governance.

title: Manager - Engineering
description:
**About ScienceLogic…**
 ScienceLogic is redefining IT operations for the modern enterprise. Our AIOps platform empowers organizations to achieve Autonomic IT — where systems are self\-healing, self\-optimizing, and seamlessly aligned with business outcomes. We help enterprises and service providers gain unified visibility across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments, automate workflows, and unlock performance at scale.
   

  

 We’re accelerating digital transformation through the power of automation, AI, and analytics — giving IT and business leaders the tools to deliver superior customer experiences, drive efficiency, and innovate with confidence.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For…**
 ScienceLogic is hiring an Engineering Manager for our PowerPack team based in our Hyderabad office. This role will manage a team of approximately 20 software engineers and SDETs responsible for the development, quality, and ongoing evolution of the PowerPack portfolio. You will report to the Director of Product Engineering (India) and will be a member of the India engineering leadership team. This is a people\-first leadership role with meaningful technical responsibility. We are looking for an experienced engineering leader who can build trust, develop future leaders, drive execution, and thoughtfully apply AI\-enabled practices to improve engineering outcomes.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing…**
 You’ll lead a team of approximately 20 engineers comprised of full\-time employees and, covering responsibilities across:
   

  

**People \& Growth**
* Conduct regular 1:1s with team members, providing coaching, feedback, and career development support.
* Hiring: run screening and calibration with recruiting partners, and own onboarding for new hires.
* Management of Contractors performance monitoring and support through contractor\-to\-FTE conversion process.
* Performance management and career development conversations that go beyond the annual review.
* Team health across the org: morale and psychological safety, not just velocity metrics.
* Conflict resolution and mediation to keep the team cohesive under pressure.


**Delivery \& Execution**
* Weekly alignment with your Product Owner on priorities, roadmap, and backlog, and with the leads you're developing as they take on more scope.
* Sprint execution accountability across both working groups, including capacity planning.
* Handling major or complex escalations, including regular syncs to work through what's outstanding.
* Tracking delivery metrics (velocity, uptime, bug counts, deployment frequency) and reporting progress, risk, and dependencies to stakeholders.


**Technical Leadership**
* Architecture and design review for pull requests, ensuring sound technical decisions across the team's work.
* Promoting engineering best practices: testing, code review, documentation, and CI/CD.
* Sponsoring and helping lead cross\-team technical initiatives, such as major platform migrations and release\-process automation.
* Running demo sessions and hands\-on skill\-building with the team on key technical areas.


**AI\-Enabled Engineering**
* Identify where AI creates real leverage in your team's engineering workflows, and act on it yourself, not just approve it from a distance.
* Work alongside engineers to design and deliver AI\-enabled solutions to real product and delivery problems.
* Build your team's capability to use AI as a working tool, including hands\-on training for engineers who are still building that muscle.


**Org Design**
* Today, the org runs flat: you manage all 20 engineers directly, organized across two informally\-led working groups.
* A key responsibility of this role is to identify and develop emerging leaders, establish a Team Lead layer, and evolve the organization into a more scalable team structure over time.


**Qualities you possess…**
* Experience:
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline
* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 3\-5 years leading engineering teams.
* Proven track record of delivering high\-impact software products, with the willingness to roll up your sleeves and work directly with engineers when needed.
* Experience managing engineering teams of this size directly, and a track record of developing individual engineers into first\-line leaders, even where that title doesn't formally exist yet.
* Self\-starter with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
* Technical Competence:
* Strong understanding of modern software architecture and distributed systems.
* Proficiency in Python and REST APIs, with familiarity across other technology stacks.
* Proficiency in database technologies and event\-driven architecture.
* Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), CI/CD, and testing methodologies.
* Hands\-on, personal experience building or shipping at least one AI\-enabled feature: you were in the technical problem, contributing to design and trade\-offs, not sponsoring or approving someone else's work.
* Leadership \& Management:
* Exceptional leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills, with a visible track record of developing engineers with diverse experience levels and career aspirations.
* Demonstrated ability to build, motivate, and retain high\-performing engineering teams, with strong delivery instincts across sprint accountability, capacity planning, and cross\-team coordination.
* Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills with engineers, peers, and senior leadership.


**As a plus, you have...**
* Experience in a GCC, IDC, or other geographically distributed engineering environment.
* Product engineering background: ownership of outcomes, not just delivery of tasks.
* Familiarity with AIOps, monitoring, observability, or enterprise SaaS domains.
* Engineering background with hands\-on depth in Python, REST APIs, or cloud\-native development, enough that you're credible in architecture and design conversations, even though you won't be writing production code day to day in this role.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum at scale, where ceremonies drive outcomes rather than checkbox rituals.
* Familiarity with JavaScript and frameworks like React.
* Exposure towards Spec Driven Development(AI\-DLC) and or TDD


*Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At ScienceLogic, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which you are applying.*
**About ScienceLogic**
 ScienceLogic is a leader in IT Operations Management, providing modern IT operations with actionable insights to resolve and predict problems faster in a digital, ephemeral world. Its solution sees everything across cloud and distributed architectures, contextualizes data through relationship mapping, and acts on this insight through integration and automation.
   

  

 www.sciencelogic.com

title: Lead Test Engineer
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
   

  

 Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
   

  

 The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high\-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**
* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well\-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).


**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
 Being a member of testing team under IT Enterprise Architecture Data and Corporate Technology department, the Enterprise Test Engineering ("ETE") family is responsible for ensuring that all applications and systems meet defined quality standards. The ETE family encompasses three major areas including (a) functional testing, (b) non\-functional testing, and (c) test architecture and enablement. Other key focuses include: regression testing, browser testing, performance testing, capacity and stress testing, resiliency testing, environment management services, and infrastructure testing. Develops, conducts, and evaluates testing processes, working closely with developers to remediate identified system defects. In\-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches including the creation of reusable foundational test automation framework for the entire organization. The Test Engineering role is responsible for ensuring that all applications, system products, projects, and solutions meet defined enterprise quality standards. Provide centralized, independent quality assurance services across the firm, including functional and non\-functional testing for all products, services, and applications across businesses. Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions, providing testing expertise, oversight, and direction to ensure the functionality of solutions and that design specifications are met.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities**
* Responsible for system integration testing, including automation, of newly developed or enhanced applications.
* Play an active role in translating business and functional requirements into concrete results.
* Lead, develop, and advise on test automation strategies and provide critical feedback in requirements, design, implementation and execution phases.
* Partner with collaborators \- Product Management, Application Development, DevOps and other technical teams.
* Track test execution milestones and report on issues and risks with the potential to affect project timelines.
* Construct appropriate end\-2\-end business scenarios through the application of a broad understanding of business objectives and goals.
* Responsible for Delivery Pipeline adoption
* Identify dependencies for environmental and data requirements.
* Contribute to standard framework of reusable functions.
* Develop a thorough understanding of the product(s) being delivered.
* Responsible for process compliance \& associated documentation
* Aligns risk and control processes into day\-to\-day responsibilities to supervise and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately.
* Works closely with business and application development domain experts, to continually improve depth and breadth of knowledge for assigned applications/systems.
* Responsible for Project Coordination and Technical Management tasks.


 \*\*NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. \*\*
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Minimum 6 years of related experience in delivering software solutions with hands on automated testing.
* Bachelor's degree preferred and/or equivalent experience.


**Talents Needed For Success**
* Experience in Agile/Waterfall, onsite/offshore work model and coordination.
* In depth knowledge of the software implementation lifecycle (specifically the testing model, methodology, and processes).
* Experience with Test Engineering methodologies and Test Automation Frameworks
* Proficient in automation at all software layers (e.g. UI, services, APIs, etc.) as well as CI/CD technologies (e.g. Cloudbees, Jenkins, Cucumber, Git, JUnit, Jira, etc.).
* Sophisticated Java / Selenium development skills with significant experience applying those skills in test environments.
* Track test execution milestones, report on issues and risks with the potential to affect project timelines.
* Extensive experience with testing modern scripting language\-based components.
* Proven expertise in frontend test automation using Selenium Webdriver.
* Expert and hands on with backend test automation for API testing (e.g. Rest Assured, Karate, Postman) and database testing (e.g. Oracle/ DB2/ Snowflake).
* Experience in writing sophisticated SQL queries.
* Experience with JIRA, ALM, Bitbucket, Git, and Jenkins.
* Requires the ability to work with both business clients and technical team and the ability to work independently, both individually and as part of a team.
* Experience in mentoring junior test engineers, verifying work products and providing mentorship, as needed.
* Unix, Python and AWS experience in a plus.
* Accountable for process compliance \& associated documentation
* Aligns risk and control processes into day\-to\-day responsibilities to supervise and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately.
* Excellent problem\-solving, collaboration, and written and verbal communication skills.


 Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
**About StarRez**
 StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off\-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400\+ clients across 25\+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user\-friendly, all\-in\-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.
   

  

**Role:**
 As a Senior Quality Engineer \- you will play a pivotal role in elevating our quality practices across StarRez communication, Marketplace, System Administration and Maintenance systems. You will be an expert within our product engineering organization, deeply understanding user and product behaviour, customer journeys, business rules, and the systems that support StarRez personas. This role will balance hands\-on individual contributor responsibilities with leading, influencing, and coaching your peers.
   

  

 This individual contributor role is for someone who is passionate about seeing systems holistically, has a strong vision for product quality, and is eager to drive the highest standards of customer experience, functional correctness, usability, accessibility, reliability, performance, and release confidence. You will leverage your deep understanding of SaaS product behaviour, end\-to\-end workflows, integrations, environments, and customer operations to guide and influence our development process.
   

  

 Your role is not to manage a team, but to be a quality champion who partners directly with developers, product managers, designers, support, implementation, and customer\-facing teams. You will help teams anticipate risk, clarify expected behaviour, validate business logic, protect the customer experience, and build more robust, scalable, and reliable conference and event products. At the core of this role is a strong focus on the customer experience; success means our platform behaves predictably, is easy to use, and enables our resident communities to thrive.
   

  

**What You Will Own:**
* Own and drive end\-to\-end quality for the StarRez Foundations product team.
* Champion StarRez's quality standards by establishing, maintaining, and advocating for quality gates and rapid feedback loops throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
* Design and execute testing, validation and risk mitigation strategies for feature related initiatives.
* Partner with Product, Design and Engineering from ideation through delivery to ensure acceptance criteria, personas, customer journeys, test data, edge cases, non\-functional expectations, and quality gates reflect real customer operations and the intended product experience.
* Champion shift\-left quality culture by mentoring developers, product managers, and design partners on testing principles, behavioural specifications, clear acceptance criteria, early validation, fast feedback loops, and production\-quality observability.
* Work effectively with ambiguity, proactively designing quality solutions based on evidence when clear requirements, behaviour definitions, customer workflow expectations, or quality baselines do not yet exist.
* Champion test automation best practices, create clear testing standards, and coach engineers to take shared ownership of building and maintaining automated tests.
* Apply AI tools and techniques to improve product quality and enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of quality engineering practices and processes.
* Own production defect triage for your product domain, partnering with Engineering, Product, and Support to assess impact, prioritise fixes, identify root causes, and drive preventative quality improvements.


**Required Qualifications:**
* 5\+ years of progressive software engineering or quality engineering with deep focus on quality in complex, distributed systems environments
* SQL. Required for test data setup, backend validation, data integrity checks across integrations, and root cause analysis.
* Tech stack context (.NET/C\#, SQL Server, Azure).
* API testing tooling (Postman, REST Assured, or similar).
* Cloud platform exposure (Azure/AWS).
* Proven track record advocating for quality and ability to influence technical direction through innovative, pragmatic, and evidence\-based approaches.
* Hands\-on experience working with web\-based products, including front\-end behaviour, API, service integration and functional end\-to\-end testing.
* Experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
* Practical experience integrating automated tests and quality checks into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub, Build\-kite, or similar platforms.
* Experience contributing to deployment and release quality gates, including test suite selection, environment readiness checks.
* Genuine curiosity and passion for understanding product architecture, user experience flows, customer workflows, analytics use cases, and the business impact of engineering and data decisions.
* Experience utilising AI in modern software development.


**Reasons to join our team:**
* Opportunity to be a part of a well\-established, high\-performance company that has been in business for over 30\+ years
* Full benefits including health care, paid time off, and others
* A supportive team environment with emphasis on learning and development opportunities
* Our Promise: You will learn, grow, and be appreciated for your impact and contributions.
* Z\-Factor: Our most celebrated value, you will work with a team of caring, high\-performing, and passionate people who have fun supporting our vision, innovation, and continuous improvement.


 Even if you don't have all of the Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!
   

  

 StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

title: DE-ET-Deployment Engineer Senior-GDS

 As an FDE in Digital Engineering, you will work directly with clients to co\-create, engineer, and scale AI\-first digital solutions that accelerate business outcomes. You will play a critical role in translating business problems into PDLC\-driven solutions, rapidly moving from POCs to enterprise\-grade platforms, and embedding GenAI, data, and cloud\-native engineering into core business workflows.
   

  

 You will be instrumental in driving future\-ready digital engineering capabilities across product engineering, platform modernization, and AI\-enabled transformation programs.

 Customer Engagement \& Solution Delivery
   

  

* Partner with clients to shape business problems into solution hypotheses aligned to PDLC (Product Delivery Lifecycle).
* Drive co\-creation workshops, rapid prototyping, and outcome\-led solution design.
* Translate ambiguous requirements into architecture, data flows, and scalable engineering constructs.
* Deliver end\-to\-end solutions spanning discovery, POC, MVP, and enterprise\-scale rollout.

**Engineering \& Development**

* Develop accelerators, reusable components, and engineering patterns for repeatable delivery.
* Work across APIs, microservices, event\-driven systems, and composable architectures.
* Integrate GenAI copilots, agents, and automation into enterprise workflows.
* Drive engineering excellence (performance, scalability, resilience, security).


 Emerging Technology Enablement
   

  

* Apply and scale cutting\-edge capabilities across:
+ Generative AI \& Agentic AI (LLMs, copilots, multi\-agent systems)
+ Data platforms \& real\-time intelligence
+ Cloud\-native \& platform engineering (Azure/AWS/GCP)
+ Automation \& intelligent workflows

* Evaluate, incubate, and industrialize new tools, frameworks, and accelerators within DE.

**Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management**

* Provide technical leadership in FDE engagements, influencing architecture and delivery direction.

description:

**PETADATA is looking for a highly experienced Senior Testing Lead with 8\+ years of experience to own the overall quality strategy, build and scale test automation, and lead functional, performance, security, API, and data\-validation testing for a data migration platform operating across cloud and on\-premise environments.**
**Roles \& Responsibilities** 
**Quality Strategy \& Leadership**
* Own and define the overall QA and testing strategy across functional, automation, performance, security, and data\-integrity testing.
* Establish quality gates, release criteria, testing standards, metrics, and reporting.
* Identify and prioritize testing efforts based on business and technical risk, especially data\-correctness risks.
* Build and manage the quality function with minimal supervision.
* Mentor developers and QA engineers and promote a quality\-first engineering culture.
* Partner closely with Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Security, and Implementation teams.


**Test Automation**
* Design and build test automation frameworks from scratch.
* Develop automated UI, API, integration, and regression testing solutions.
* Use tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, and REST/API automation frameworks.
* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Build scalable regression suites that improve release velocity and confidence.
* Use programming languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java for automation.


**Functional \& Migration Testing**
* Own end\-to\-end functional testing across supported CRM platforms and migration scenarios.
* Test standard and custom objects, relationships, transformations, mappings, and edge cases.
* Design test scenarios based on real\-world customer data migration use cases.
* Validate migration correctness from source to destination.
* Test multi\-tenant behavior, configuration, and tenant data isolation.
* Identify defects and ensure issues are properly investigated, resolved, and prevented from recurring.


**Data Validation \& Integrity** 
  

  

* Build automated source\-to\-target data validation frameworks.
* Validate:
+ Record counts
+ Field\-level accuracy
+ Data mappings
+ Relationships and associations
+ Transformations
+ Deduplication
+ Overall data integrity

* Use SQL and programmatic validation techniques to verify migration results.
* Ensure migrated customer data remains complete, accurate, and consistent.


**Performance Testing**
* Design and execute load, stress, scalability, and performance testing.
* Test large data volumes and high numbers of concurrent migrations.
* Establish performance baselines, benchmarks, and SLAs.
* Identify performance bottlenecks and work with Engineering and Architecture teams to resolve them.
* Use tools such as k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust.
* Integrate appropriate performance testing into the CI/CD pipeline.


**Security Testing**
* Perform and coordinate security testing across the application and platform.
* Test tenant isolation and ensure no cross\-tenant data access is possible.
* Validate authentication and authorization controls.
* Perform input validation and abuse\-case testing.
* Integrate SAST, DAST, and vulnerability scanning into CI/CD.
* Coordinate penetration testing with internal security teams and external security vendors.
* Support security and compliance requirements such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001 through appropriate testing evidence.


**Technical Quality \& Delivery**
* Ensure software is secure, scalable, reliable, and production\-ready.
* Establish automated quality checks throughout the development lifecycle.
* Collaborate with developers to identify defects early.
* Review testing approaches and improve overall engineering quality.
* Support both cloud and on\-premise deployments.
* Help establish reliable test environments using cloud, containers, and infrastructure automation.


**Note: Should be highly self\-directed, comfortable building the QA function from the ground up, and able to work effectively with distributed engineering teams across required time zones.**
**Note: Should be able to work independently and work in USA time zones**
**Required Skills**
* 8\+ years of professional QA / Test Engineering experience.
* Strong experience leading QA strategy and quality engineering for software products.
* Strong hands\-on experience building test automation frameworks from scratch.
* Proficiency with Playwright, Cypress, and/or Selenium.
* Strong API and REST testing experience.
* Strong programming experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java.
* Hands\-on experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with functional, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Strong experience with performance/load testing using JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust, or similar tools.
* Working knowledge of security testing, including OWASP, authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, SAST, DAST, and vulnerability scanning.
* Strong SQL and data\-validation experience.
* Experience validating source\-to\-target data integrity across multiple systems.
* Strong understanding of data migration, ETL, integration, or data\-intensive applications.
* Experience testing multi\-tenant SaaS applications.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

* Ability to independently establish testing processes, frameworks, quality standards, and release criteria.


**Education**

title: Sr Manager, Software Development & Engineering Lead
description:
Your opportunity
   

  

 At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
   

  

 Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region .
   

  

 What you have
   

  

**Required Skills**
**Education \& Experience:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field
* 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, including 3–5\+ years in people leadership roles
* Proven experience managing medium\-to\-large, complex programs with multiple dependencies
* Experience in financial services or brokerage domain preferred Technical \& Leadership Expertise
* Strong knowledge of SDLC, Agile methodologies, and enterprise software engineering practices
* Experience building and operating highly available, scalable distributed systems
* Hands\-on experience or strong exposure to mainframe and modern distributed ecosystems


**AI \& Modern Engineering Capabilities**
* Demonstrated experience driving AI\-assisted engineering adoption \& AI\-DLC
* Familiarity with Generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, AI coding assistants) and their application in enterprise environments
* Understanding of automation, agentic workflows, and AI\-driven productivity acceleration (preferred practical exposure)
* Leadership \& Soft Skills
* Strong coaching, mentoring, and talent development capabilities
* Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced, globally distributed environments
* Self\-starter with strong prioritization and multitasking capabilities


**Technical Qualifications**
* Demonstrated ability to analyze, propose and implement timely, cost effective, quality solutions for all issues or problems within area of responsibility
* Demonstrated ability to facilitate technical discussions and drive solutions forward to achieve business needs and ensure alignment to strategic technology vision
* Demonstrated experience with designing or working with highly available and reliable systems including work on technical design, defining SLAs, KPIs for tracking and improving software reliability
* Experience facilitating issue intervention and driving improvements
* Skills in risks identification, tracking and planned mitigation
* Strong written and verbal communication skills


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and continuous delivery practices
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Rally, ChangeMan, BMC Remedy
* Experience leading large\-scale modernization programs using GenAI and automation
* Proven ability to drive innovation, strategic initiatives, and cross\-functional programs
* Experience building inclusive, high\-performance team cultures
* Managing Performance – Goal setting, coaching, and performance management
* Fostering Teamwork – Driving collaboration and team effectiveness
* Results Orientation – Delivering measurable outcomes aligned to business goals
* Strategic Thinking – Driving long\-term vision and transformation
* Fostering Diversity – Promoting inclusion and equitable practices
* Written \& Verbal Communication – Clear articulation across audience


 What’s in it for you
   

  

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.
   

  

**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**
* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Education assistance for continued learning to help you grow
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check\-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day\-to\-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance


 Apply
