title: TD&E-FS-Technical Scrum Master- Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**echnology Consulting**
**Title:** 
**Specialist II, Technical Scrum Lead**
 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
   

  

 Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**EY Technology:**
 Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
   

  

**EY Technology** 
 supports our technology needs through three business units:
   

  

**Client Technology (CT) \-** 
 focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
   

  

**Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) –** 
 EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
   

  

**Information Security (Info Sec) \-** 
 Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The Technical Scrum Lead, Specialist is responsible for driving Agile adoption and execution within technology teams, ensuring efficient sprint execution and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. This role involves facilitating Agile ceremonies, such as sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews and retrospectives, to keep teams aligned and productive.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead cross\-functional agile teams in iterative technology development, ensuring smooth collaboration and adherence to Agile/Scrum principles.
* Coach teams on best practices, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improving agile maturity.
* Work closely with product owners and stakeholders to define, prioritize and align technology\-related outcomes with business goals.
* Identify and proactively remove roadblocks that hinder project progress, ensuring teams have the necessary resources and support.
* Manage stakeholder expectations by maintaining transparency around scope, schedule and budget while effectively addressing concerns.
* Facilitate key agile ceremonies such as daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives to ensure alignment and continuous improvement.
* Assist teams in estimating deliverables, increasing velocity and identifying opportunities for efficiency.
* Maintain product and sprint backlogs, ensuring tasks are documented, prioritized and aligned with evolving business needs.
* Apply agile methodologies to integrate changing customer inputs and business conditions into technology\-related product development.
* Serve as a mentor, thought leader and agile champion, participating in special projects to drive organizational agility.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience, with at least 5 years in Agile project management, Scrum Master roles, or technical leadership in software development.
* Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Strong expertise in Scrum, Kanban and SAFe frameworks, with a deep understanding of Agile principles and best practices.
* Hands\-on experience with JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps and other Agile project management tools.
* Proficiency in coding and technical concepts, including Java, Angular, Node.js, POSTMAN, CUCUMBER, AWS and SQL queries.
* Familiarity with version control and CI/CD tools such as GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, TDD/BDD and monitoring tools like Splunk and Honeycomb.
* Experience in monitoring and refining dashboards, optimizing workflows, and driving continuous process improvements in Agile environments.
* AWS Cloud Practitioner certification and Professional Scrum Master (CSM, PSM, SAFe) certification is preferred.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship\-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)


**What We Look For**
* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well\-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Project Coordinator- Migration
description:
**Migration Coordinator** 




**Location: India \- Remote** 




  





**Job Profile Summary** 




 The Migration Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and governing day\-to\-day migration activities across multiple customers, workstreams, and technical teams. This role serves as the central coordination point between Project Managers, Program Managers, technical delivery teams, service management teams, customers, and third\-party partners to ensure migration activities are planned, scheduled, executed, and tracked in accordance with program objectives.
 



 The role combines migration coordination and PMO responsibilities, including migration wave scheduling, migration readiness management, customer communications, ServiceNow or any ticket governance, reporting, tracking of planned versus actual delivery status, and risk and dependency management. The Migration Coordinator is expected to maintain accurate migration data, provide visibility into program progress, proactively identify issues, and support effective program governance.
 



  





**Career Level Summary** 



* Manages routine and complex migration coordination activities across multiple customers and workstreams.
* Works with technical and business stakeholders to support migration planning, execution, and governance.



  





**Critical Competencies** 



* Excellence: Delivers high\-quality coordination and governance support through strong attention to detail, accountability, and consistent execution.
* Customer\-Driven: Ensures customers are informed, prepared, and supported throughout migration planning and execution activities.
* Expertise: Applies PMO and migration coordination knowledge to maintain control over schedules, readiness activities, reporting, governance, and ticket management processes.
* Collaboration: Builds effective working relationships across technical teams, program leadership, operational teams, customers, and external partners.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Manage day\-to\-day migration wave scheduling and coordination activities across multiple customers, services, applications, and infrastructure environments.
* Maintain migration schedules and ensure alignment with program milestones, migration roadmaps, and delivery objectives.
* Coordinate migration dates, resource availability, dependencies, readiness activities, and prerequisites required for successful execution.
* Track migration readiness and ensure required approvals; validations, access requirements, and prerequisites are completed before scheduled migration dates.
* Identify scheduling conflicts, resource constraints, delivery risks, and dependency\-related challenges, escalating where appropriate.
* Manage migration\-related customer communications, including scheduling notifications, reminders, status updates, confirmations, and follow\-up actions.
* Maintain high standards of ServiceNow or any other ticket management governance across migration activities.
* Ensure migration\-related tickets are accurately created, assigned, categorized, updated, reviewed, and closed according to agreed processes.
* Maintain migration trackers, action logs, RAID logs, readiness trackers, dashboards, and governance documentation.
* Maintain risk, issue, action, and dependency registers and ensure assigned owners actively progress in remediation activities.
* Act as the primary coordination point between migration teams, project managers, service management teams, operations, customers, and external vendors.



  





**Knowledge** 



* Knowledge of PMO methodologies, governance frameworks, reporting processes, and project coordination practices.
* Proven ability to identify schedule slippage, risks, dependencies, and blockers and drive appropriate follow\-up actions.



  





**Skills** 



* Migration Coordination
* PMO Governance and Reporting
* Migration Wave Planning and Scheduling
* Stakeholder Management (Internal and External)
* Customer Communication Management
* ServiceNow / ITSM Platforms
* Schedule Management and Tracking
* Migration Readiness Management
* Risk, Issue, Action and Dependency Management (RAID)
* Data Analysis and Reporting
* Microsoft Excel, Dashboards and Tracker Management



  





**Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or related fields required.



  





**Certifications** 



* PMP, CAPM, or equivalent Project Management Certification preferred.
* Agile Foundation, Scrum Fundamentals, or comparable project delivery certification preferred.



  





**Experience** 



* Minimum 3\-6 years of experience in PMO, project coordination, migration coordination, transition management, service delivery, or related operational roles.

title: Senior Consultant – Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC) – Data Technical Program Management
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 As a Senior consultant within the GES Technology Group, reporting to Digital delivery leader, you will work closely with Product and engineering functions to lead cross\-functional programs spanning data engineering, analytics, integration, architecture, product, security, and business stakeholders. You will drive delivery of scalable data platforms and integration solutions, including initiatives involving AI driven analytics, master data management, data lake enablement, APIs, event\-driven integrations, Model Context Protocol implementations and others.
   

  

 You will serve as the connective tissue across business, product, engineering, and leadership teams—ensuring that complex data and integration programs are delivered with clear outcomes, disciplined execution, and effective risk management.
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad
   

  

 Shift Timings: 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM
   

  

 Key job responsibilities:
   

  

* Own and manage the end\-to\-end Compliance PMO plan for software releases, including SSDLC governance milestones, approval dependencies, timelines, and escalation paths.
* Drive coordination of all required compliance approvals for releases, including BISO, quality, risk, data privacy, cyber, and other governance signoffs as applicable.
* Coordinate and gather information required for compliance documentation, including data privacy assessments, risk inputs, control evidence, and supporting artifacts from various product domain teams.
* Drive engagement with member firm and local geography risk leaders to socialize release scope, confirm required risk considerations, share evidence of global risk compliance process approvals and coordinate responses to questions pertaining to risk controls of the software and/or process.
* Partner with product, engineering, QA, security, privacy, risk, operations, and business teams to ensure release deliverables meet SSDLC control requirements before go/no\-go decisions.
* Maintain a centralized compliance tracker that captures approval status, required artifacts, open risks, blockers, owners, target dates, and closure evidence for each release.
* Identify, document, monitor, and escalate compliance risks, approval delays, control gaps, and release readiness issues with clear mitigation plans and ownership.
* Facilitate compliance readiness reviews, approval checkpoints, risk reviews, and compliance go/no\-go meetings to support timely and controlled release decisions.
* Ensure required release evidence is complete, current, auditable, and aligned to applicable quality and risk, privacy, cyber, and SSDLC standards.
* Provide regular executive\-ready reporting on compliance approval status, key risks, decisions needed, and upcoming governance milestones.
* Continuously improve Compliance PMO processes, approval workflows, templates, dashboards, and documentation to increase transparency and reduce release friction.
* Support post\-release reviews by capturing lessons learned, compliance exceptions, residual risks, and process improvement opportunities.
* Support hypercare and on\-demand release activities by confirming required compliance approvals, documenting exceptions, and coordinating time\-sensitive governance decisions for high\-priority production issues.


 Key Skills:
   

  

* Ideally 5\+ years of experience working in technical program management, technology delivery, data engineering, integration, analytics, or a related field.
* Technology project or release governance experience with Azure DevOps / JIRA or similar software product development management tools, including experience tracking milestones, approvals, risks, and dependencies
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi\-team data, integration, analytics, or platform programs.
* Experience managing programs across data engineering, application development, architecture, cloud, security, and business teams.
* Strong understanding of data lifecycle concepts, including ingestion, transformation, storage, modeling, quality, governance, and consumption.
* Experience with enterprise integration patterns, including APIs, batch processing, event\-driven integration, file exchange, and application\-to\-application integration.
* Experience coordinating data platform or data lake implementations.
* Experience with master data management, data quality, data governance, or Informatica\-based solutions.
* Familiarity with data lakehouse architectures and technologies such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol and AI\-enabled data or system integrations.
* Experience with data catalogs, lineage, metadata management, data observability, or data mesh concepts.
* Familiarity with analytics and visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
* Proficiency with the Microsoft suite of applications such as Excel, PowerPoint, Project and other collaboration tools such as SharePoint and Teams
* Strong working knowledge of SSDLC governance, release readiness controls, approval checkpoints, and evidence management
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional compliance approvals across quality, risk, data privacy, cyber, engineering, QA, operations, and business stakeholders
* Ability to manage compliance trackers, release dashboards, approval artifacts, audit evidence, RAID logs, and executive\-ready status reporting
* Able to collaborate effectively as part of a global, remote team
* Strong analytical, consultative, quantitative, and project management skills
* Strong executive presence, excellent communication (verbal and written) and presentation skills with an aptitude for working as part of a global team
* Problem solving, critical thinking and conceptual thinking skills

title: Engineering Manager - MeanStack
description:
**About the Role:** 




 The Engineering Manager position entails the leadership of MCO global product development teams across the entirety of the software development life cycle. This role focuses on our MEAN stack platform (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular, Node.js) hosted on AWS, with MongoDB Atlas as the primary data layer. Key responsibilities encompass ensuring the quality of team outputs and optimizing customer experiences, along with maintaining strict adherence to coding standards and promoting automation initiatives.
 



 The role involves mentoring and guiding engineers, proactively identifying and mitigating technical risks, and facilitating effective communication between engineering and other stakeholders. The manager oversees deployment processes across AWS infrastructure, monitors system performance, and provides decisive technical leadership during incidents. Ultimately, this role aims to uphold the highest standards of professionalism and innovation in MCO software development practices.
 



**Responsibilities** 




**Agile \& Team Leadership** 



* Own the effectiveness of the Scrum Agile process and adherence to good agile practices for the team.
* Be responsible for the quality of the teams’ outputs and the customer experience of our products.
* Lead product development teams through all stages of the SDLC, from requirements gathering through production deployment on AWS.
* Foster a collaborative and innovative engineering culture focused on delivering high\-quality software products.
* Mentor and coach engineers to foster their technical growth and career development, with emphasis on modern JavaScript/TypeScript best practices.



**Technical Leadership – MEAN Stack \& AWS** 



* Hands\-on participation in all technical activities including architecture and design reviews, code reviews, coding, troubleshooting, and defect triage across the MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular, Node.js).
* Define and enforce coding standards and best practices within the engineering team for TypeScript/JavaScript, Angular component architecture, RESTful API design, and Node.js services.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure high code quality and adherence to engineering standards across the full stack.
* Oversee MongoDB Atlas configuration, schema design, indexing strategies, aggregation pipelines, and data migration processes.
* Drive architecture decisions for AWS services including EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, and related infrastructure.
* Identify technical risks and challenges early in the project lifecycle and propose mitigation strategies, particularly around scalability, security, and cloud cost optimisation.



**Delivery \& Operations** 



* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate product requirements into technical specifications.
* Drive automation in the engineering teams, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform/CloudFormation), and automated testing.
* Drive continuous improvement in development processes and tools to increase efficiency and quality.
* Act as a technical liaison between engineering, product management, and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate with Platform Test teams to ensure thorough testing and validation of software products.
* Oversee deployment and release processes using AWS\-based CI/CD to ensure smooth and reliable product launches.
* Monitor system performance via CloudWatch, application logging, and APM tooling; address technical issues promptly to maintain product stability.
* Provide technical leadership during incidents and outages, facilitating root cause analysis and resolution across the application and infrastructure layers.



**Experiences and Skills** 




**Required** 



* 10\+ years of experience in product development (including up to 3 years in engineering management).
* Strong full\-stack engineering experience with the MEAN stack: MongoDB, Express.js, Angular (2\+), and Node.js in a product development environment.
* Proven experience designing and operating production workloads on AWS, including services such as EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, and RDS/DocumentDB or MongoDB Atlas.
* Hands\-on proficiency with MongoDB Atlas: cluster management, performance tuning, indexing, aggregation framework, change streams, and backup/restore strategies.
* Maintain hands\-on involvement with coding approximately 20% of the time.
* Expertise in architecture and design reviews, system design, code reviews, customer issues, troubleshooting, and defect triage.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to resolve complex distributed\-systems issues.
* Demonstrates resilience and flexibility, consistently adapting while managing priorities with efficiency.
* A strong willingness to learn and a growth mindset.
* Excellent communication and servant\-leadership skills.
* Knowledge and experience of agile development methodology (Scrum, Agile, and Kanban).



**Preferred** 



* Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or CDK).
* Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS ECS/EKS).
* Experience with event\-driven architectures, message queues (SQS, SNS, Kafka), and microservices patterns.
* Background in a product\-driven SaaS or financial services company.



 Architect\-level experience is a plus.
